conditions: FTDI states that VCP support is integrated into the Linux kernel; custom VID/PID configurations may require the vendor's TN-101 guidance.

evidence.source_note: FTDI states that all FTDI devices are supported in Ubuntu 11.10 with kernel 3.0.0-19 and that VCP drivers are integrated into the Linux kernel.

limitations: Kernel-integrated support is not an exact distribution/kernel reproduction for every later Ubuntu release.
